local_articles.title: Heavy downpours expected in the Pittsburgh area on Saturday | First Alert Weather
local_articles.snippet: Today is a First Alert Weather Day with heavy downpours and storms leading to possible flash flooding from noon until 1 a.m. Sunday. We are under a marginal risk for severe weather, which is a 1 out of 5, meaning a lower confidence that storms will become severe. Flooding will be the biggest threat this afternoon and evening. Anywhere from 1-3" is possible for rainfall amounts today across the region. On Sunday, we will see decreasing clouds to start off with highs in the low 80s. There's a small chance for an isolated shower or thunderstorm in the evening. Much of the day is dry, but there will be some isolated areas that get a quick shower or storm in the evening. Tomorrow is also a marginal risk (1 out of 5) for severe weather, so there is lower confidence that storms will become severe. questions.current_reasoning: Modestly upgrading Camp Nou (0.65 -> 0.70) over Wembley Stadium (0.35 -> 0.30) in this confirmed two-stadium race ahead of the UEFA Executive Committee decision in Thessaloniki on September 15. A fresh Sept 9 EFE/Infobae pre-vote report explicitly identifies Camp Nou as the favorite over Wembley, highlighting that the renovated Barcelona venue will be Europe's largest stadium (104,600 capacity, first UCL final since 1999) whereas Wembley is already locked in to host both semifinals and the final of Euro 2028 less than a year earlier (after also hosting the 2024 UCL final). questions.title: Which country will be the first in 2026 to publicly acknowledge deploying purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit?
questions.background: Military satellites provide communications, navigation and intelligence services. Deploying weapons in orbit could significantly change how countries protect or threaten these systems.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by national governments or military officials, corroborated by reliable international news reporting. Qualifying Event : Resolve to the country whose government or military first publicly acknowledges during 2026 that it has already deployed purpose-built weapons in Earth orbit. Merely describing satellites with potential military applications, announcing future deployments, or confirming ground-based anti-satellite weapons does not qualify. Resolution Timing : Resolve on the date of the first qualifying public acknowledgment, provided it occurs by December 31, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-09-06 check (Exa + Sept 2 Reuters/Straits Times investigation 'US, China arm for space warfare: hunter satellites and orbital weapons'): No country has yet publicly acknowledged already-deployed orbital weapons. Crucially, the Sept 2 Reuters report sharpens the asymmetry in public-acknowledgment propensity: China's Foreign Ministry reiterated on the record that Beijing opposes space weaponization and insists its spaceplane/Shiyan missions are peaceful/experimental, and Moscow continues denying its nuclear ASAT program. By contrast, US SPACECOM head Gen. Stephen Whiting is openly arguing for an active warfighting posture and orbital interceptors, incoming Space Force CSO Lt. Gen. Douglas Schiess led the newly disclosed US-UK orbital proximity operation, and the Space Force already broke silence in June with a rare disclosure of an earthbound L3Harris ASAT jammer—building toward potential deterrence disclosures at the mid-September AFA Air, Space & Cyber Conference. Lifting United States (0.49 -> 0.53) while trimming Russia (0.25 -> 0.23) and China (0.12 -> 0.10), with France (0.08, Yoda) and India (0.03) steady (sum = 0.97).

questions.title: Which city will be awarded hosting rights for the 2029 World Athletics Championships?
questions.background: World Athletics selects the host cities for its biennial outdoor track-and-field world championships.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : World Athletics' official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 World Athletics Championships. Resolution : Resolve when World Athletics first publicly announces the successful host city. The initial award determines the answer, regardless of any subsequent changes. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the name of the selected city, not the country or stadium.
questions.current_reasoning: Key August 10-14 bidding confirmations (BBC Sport, Reuters/Straits Times, KBC, Citizen Digital): The formal bid deadline passed on Aug 5 and virtual presentations to Sebastian Coe and the World Athletics Council took place on Aug 13, confirming ONLY four cities are officially bidding for the 2029 and 2031 World Athletics Championships: London, Nairobi, Rome, and Munich. New Delhi did not submit a bid and is removed (0.04 -> 0.00). Coe confirmed both 2029 and 2031 hosts will be announced simultaneously on Sept 15 after the Budapest Ultimate Championships. Reallocating the eliminated 0.04 and prior residual across the four confirmed bidders: London rises 0.52 -> 0.56 as the clearest 2029 fit (resolved West Ham/London Stadium deal specifically for Sept 2029, full UK Govt/Mayor backing, European rotation after Tokyo 2025 & Beijing 2027, and a natural London 2029 / Nairobi 2031 pairing); Nairobi rises 0.20 -> 0.22 after formally submitting and delivering President Ruto's ironclad state guarantee on Aug 13 for Africa's first hosting; proven European hosts Rome (0.11 -> 0.12) and Munich (0.10) remain live Council alternatives (sum = 1.00 across the complete four-city field).
